name: No Finite pc-Minor Basis for Convex Realizability
statement: No finite list of forbidden pc-minors characterizes convex realizability, even when the ambient classes are restricted to union-closed-orientable finite convex-treelike ample classes of VC dimension two.
proof: The family $\{D_m:m\geq4\text{ even}\}$ is an infinite antichain, and every member is pc-minimal outside realizable ampleness while satisfying every stated ambient restriction. Any complete forbidden list must therefore contain one obstruction for each member.
comments: The theorem does not identify the entire infinite global obstruction basis.
